period_note: BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, not Solo. This source (the bank's own website newspaper-style quarterly disclosure, a genuinely different and richer source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' BSEC table previously used for FY2019-2025, which is confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- no such table exists in any of those years' annual reports) presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Statement/Cash Flow Statement/Statement of Changes in Equity in every quarter checked FY2011-2018 -- no Solo section is printed in the main 3-panel layout. This is a REAL, PERVASIVE basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual series for all of FY2011-2018 (the whole block newly added this session), matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025's interim quarters (as opposed to the SOLO FY2019-2021/2023 interim quarters) -- see sources.json and insights.json's reporting_basis/data_gaps fields for the full picture across all years. Cross-validated: this file's own figures satisfy Assets=Liabilities+Equity, NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense, Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income, Profit before provision=TOI-TOE, Profit before taxation=PBP-Total provision, and Profit after taxation=PBT-Tax, all to the exact taka, and the equity components (paid-up capital+statutory reserve+other reserve+retained earnings+minority/non-controlling interest) sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity. Not linked from the current thepremierbankplc.com/financial-reports/ page; recovered via Wayback Machine (capture 2016-11-10) of an older premierbankltd.com upload path (also independently confirmed present at an even earlier 2015-04-07 capture as a byte-identical 'warc/revisit' record, i.e. the same file existed under this path from at least April 2015). PDF page itself is a scanned image (0 embedded text apart from a cover-page font) -- extracted via the embedded JPEG images at their native 1299x894/858 resolution, cropped per-panel and upscaled 4x for legibility; all figures cross-checked arithmetically (see below) and via the Statement of Changes in Equity's own roll-forward, which reproduces Total Shareholders' Equity to the taka.
